purpose: first run: the accepted #464 page tests against the pinned windows (expected red where the panel semantics changed)

results.test: E1 Ultra Chat is the default view; at load the catalog is not asked, only the saved choice for the chat badge
E2 the board: four columns, compact cards in server order, honest empty columns, a closed card holds no full card
E3 the chat-model picker next to the composer: reads the list only when opened, saves only the preference
E4 a refused or unavailable picker is told and saves nothing locally
E5 malformed or failed catalog answers show an error and no invented models
E6 saved-choice states are told honestly in the EVM summary
E7 server text is never markup, in the compact card, in place and in the side panel
E8 the way back restores the operator panel; refresh reloads the catalog
E9 the shipped page carries no model list of its own
E10 role marks and hints in the full card are exactly the server facts, in place and in the side panel
E11 one API status component: compact card, card in place, side panel and diagnostic window show the same server status
E12 full card: parameter count as given, description box editable by a visible command (in place and in the panel)
E13 settings from the card in place: server facts, never the key value, the exact edited values
E14 settings from the side panel: a bad count is refused locally, a revision conflict keeps the draft
E15 one window keeps the state of the other; closing gives the keyboard back to the command that opened it
E16 the check: one empty POST, no input field, the indicator comes only from the server
E17 without card data the compact cards show names only and nothing can be reordered, dragged or starred
E18 the roles source is told: defaults, unreadable and not connected Ultra settings
E19 the chat composer: the model picker, a disabled voice place and a disabled send
E20 damaged stores are reported, and a damaged settings file can still be saved over on purpose
E21 plain hover shows nothing; Ctrl + hover shows the side panel, switches without a blink and closes when Ctrl is released
E22 a click opens the full card in place under its row; several stay open; a second click closes; Enter / Space the same
E23 «Выше» / «Ниже» and Alt+arrows save the order of one column; the keyboard keeps its place; the ends are disabled
E24 a press becomes a drag only beyond the threshold; the release never opens the card; first, middle and last cards move
E25 buttons never start a drag; Escape, a release outside, another column, a lost pointer cancel without saving
E26 favourites by mouse: a reference is added at the place shown, never twice; the source column keeps the model
E27 favourites by star: a reference, its own order, its source as it is now
E28 «Изменить описание» opens Настройки → Модель with the cursor in the field; a click on the box does the same
E29 layout rules: four columns on a wide screen, one on a narrow one, no scroll anchoring jumps, no horizontal scroll
E30 the side panel stands beside the column of its card: right of the left columns, left of the right ones, a sheet on a narrow screen
E31 Ctrl + click, «⧉», «×» and Escape: pin, close and give the keyboard back; a press inside never closes it
E32 a drag closes an unpinned panel and keeps it closed until the drop; a pinned panel steps aside and comes back
E33 a refused order is not kept: the saved state is read again and the reason told (buttons and drag)
E34 one constructor for every kind: MCP and local entries, same tail of different kinds kept apart
E35 near the edge of the board the list scrolls by itself during a drag, and the place is found again
E36 messages are toasts outside the flow: a drop that tells something never moves the board; success goes away by itself
E37 the drag label follows the pointer at its lower right and flips near the window edges, never hiding the place pointed at

U2 the read token travels only in its own header to /ultra/chat/* and is stored nowhere

U9 sections switch both ways and \#operator / \#evm open a section directly
U10 a late answer for a Workspace that is no longer selected is ignored
U11 malformed server answers show an error and invent nothing
U12 the EVM model badge tells every saved-choice state
